metadata.description: Claude agent templates for digital-asset risk & compliance, wired to the Metrika MCP server as the live data layer. Draft work product only — every output is staged for a qualified human reviewer.
metadata.autonomyLevel: Level 2-3 (AI co-pilot / human-supervised). Not autonomous execution.

plugins.name: digital-asset-risk
plugins.description: Shared skills, slash commands, and the Metrika MCP connector for digital-asset risk & compliance. Install this first — the agents bundle its skills.

plugins.name: risk-controller
plugins.description: Morning risk briefings, incident triage, KRI-spike explanations, and escalation memos — as review-ready drafts, every claim cited to a Metrika KRI id or deep-link.

plugins.name: asset-onboarding-dd
plugins.description: Pre-onboarding risk assessments (peg, reserves, liquidity, chain health, concentration, sanctions) built on Metrika report templates. Drafts a recommendation memo for the onboarding committee — it does not approve onboarding.

plugins.name: risk-reporting
plugins.description: Board / risk-committee packs from KRI trends and incident history. Assembles a review-ready draft pack; the committee owns the decisions.
